questions.question: Which Assyrian king invaded Judah in Isaiah 36?
What did the Rabshakeh urge the people of Jerusalem to do?
options: Not let Hezekiah deceive them or trust the LORD; surrender
Flee away from the city by night before the siege begins
Tear down all of their idols and turn back to the LORD their God
Take up their arms at once and bravely defend the city walls
questions.answer: Not let Hezekiah deceive them or trust the LORD; surrender

questions.question: The people kept silent and did not answer the Rabshakeh, as the king had commanded.
On what do you rest this trust of yours? said the Rabshakeh to the people of _____.
Hezekiah's officials came to him with their clothes _____, reporting the Rabshakeh's words.
